description.value: Scott Duncan Hut is an Alpine Club of Canada backcountry wilderness hut situated at 2682 metres elevation in British Columbia, making it one of the higher-elevation ACC huts in the region. Operated by the ACC and requiring a fee, it serves as a base for mountaineering and alpine objectives in a remote setting. Touring cyclists who venture into this terrain would find basic backcountry shelter in an exceptional mountain environment.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The specific hut page returned a 404 error, so no substantive website content is available about Scott Duncan Hut itself. OSM tags provide the primary evidence: internet_access=no (Wi-Fi absent), fee=yes, operator=Alpine Club of Canada, elevation=2682m. The ACC general phone number (403-678-3200) shown on the 404 page matches the OSM phone tag, confirming that contact detail; all amenity fields beyond Wi-Fi must remain null due to lack of evidence.
concerns: OSM website URL returns a 404 Page Not Found on the Alpine Club of Canada site; the hut may have been reorganized under a new URL.

At 2682m elevation, this is a high-alpine wilderness hut likely accessible only to cyclists on demanding off-road terrain; relevance to road or gravel touring cyclists is limited but not grounds for exclusion.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, operational ACC backcountry hut at a known location; looks_closed=false and no evidence of permanent closure. Stale URL does not indicate the hut is gone.
enrichment_extras.notes: Recommend verifying the current ACC hut listing URL (e.g. via the ACC Backcountry Huts or BC Provincial Parks Huts section) and updating the OSM website tag accordingly.
